requirement_text: Applicants with citizenship from a country outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland who are offered admission, will receive information about the precise tuition fee. For the academic year 2026/2027 and 2027/2028, the following rates apply.
source_authority_note: uio.no is the official domain of the University of Oslo (website_url on the matched universities row is http://www.uio.no/english/). Norwegian national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
researcher_notes: UiO publishes rates for two future academic years at once, which is unusually forward-looking for this corpus and makes both cycle-bound rather than recurring.

limitations: Non-EU/EEA/Swiss citizens only; EU/EEA/Swiss and Norwegian students pay no tuition. Amount is per year, in NOK.
researcher_notes: Sample rows from UiO's full table, chosen to show the spread and the direction of travel. Note several programmes fall between the two years (295 000 to 218 000) while others rise (204 000 to 218 000) -- the fee is not indexed, it is set per programme per year, so a stored 'current fee' with no year attached is wrong within twelve months.

requirement_text: Several rows in UiO's table (European History; European Master in Health Economics and Management; The Psychology of Global Mobility, Inclusion and Diversity in Society) carry footnote markers and NO price in either the 2026/2027 or the 2027/2028 column.
source_authority_note: uio.no is the official domain of the University of Oslo (website_url on the matched universities row is http://www.uio.no/english/). Norwegian national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
limitations: Deliberately recorded as an absence rather than as a zero or a null-with-no-explanation. These are joint/Erasmus Mundus-style programmes whose fees are set by the consortium, and the footnote text was not captured in this pass.
researcher_notes: An empty cell in a price table is the single most dangerous shape in this dataset: ingested naively it becomes 'free'. Flagged so it cannot be.

deadline_text_verbatim: No University of Oslo application deadline was verified in this pass.
source_authority_note: uio.no is the official domain of the University of Oslo (website_url on the matched universities row is http://www.uio.no/english/). Norwegian national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
limitations: NOT A FINDING OF ABSENCE. Two candidate UiO admission URLs returned HTTP 404 on direct fetch (2026-08-22) and the deadline was not pursued further within this pass. UiO certainly publishes application deadlines; this lane did not reach them. Recorded so the gap is visible rather than looking like coverage.
researcher_notes: Distinguishing 'we checked and nothing is published' from 'we did not reach it' is the whole reason the verification_state vocabulary has both CURRENT_CYCLE_NOT_PUBLISHED and NEEDS_REVIEW. This row is the second kind.
